core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nasheed is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Anthem, song, recitation”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nasheed corresponds to the Arabic form نَشِيد (Arabic root ن ش د (n-sh-d); نَشِيد (Nashīd)). Its core sense is anthem, song, recitation. Nasheed is Arabic نَشِيد (Nashīd) 'anthem, song, recitation', from the root ن ش د (n-sh-d). The source gloss 'Song, Poem, Recitation' is consistent. Same name as nashid.
